resources.string: Ask family: is this a scam?

Puts a small button at the edge of your screen. When you tap it, My Tech Kid takes a picture of what\'s on your screen and asks you before sending it to your family, so they can tell you if it\'s a scam. Passwords and codes are covered up first. It never looks at your screen at any other time, and it never taps or types anything for you.
